questions.stem: At 0.570c an object of proper length 20.0 meters passes a detector. What length does the detector measure?

options.misconception: Divides by gamma instead of multiplying, reversing the effect
Assumes no relativistic effect operates at this speed
Applies a linear rather than Lorentz-contraction factor

Multiplying by gamma would expand the object, quoting L0 ignores contraction, and L0 times (1 - beta) is not the Lorentz formula.
questions.hint: Divide the proper length by gamma, never multiply.
